details.description: The summary of a completed sync run (counts for organizations and memberships), or an `error` message describing why the run failed; null until the task finishes.

error.description: The message of the error that caused the sync run to fail; present only when the task status is `failed`.

seen.description: The number of organizations found in Keycloak during the sync run.

added.description: The number of organizations created in the local cache by the sync run.

updated.description: The number of existing organizations confirmed against Keycloak by the sync run.

disabled.description: The number of local organization rows marked disabled by the sync run because Keycloak reports them as absent or not enabled.

seen.description: The number of memberships found in Keycloak during the sync run.

added.description: The number of memberships created in the local cache by the sync run.

updated.description: The number of existing memberships confirmed against Keycloak by the sync run.

disabled.description: The number of local membership rows marked disabled by the sync run because Keycloak no longer reports them.

createdBy.description: The keycloak user id of the PDC user that requested this sync.
